jobs.title: AgentCore Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

We’re hiring AgentCore Platform Engineers to build the agent-facing layer of the platform. That covers how agents run, remember and work together, and how they safely reach the internal systems the business already runs on. Each engineer will have a main focus in one of the two areas below and work closely across both. What you build becomes the template other teams copy, so quality and clarity matter as much as speed. This is a named-team engagement, so the person we propose is the person who starts.

We know production experience with Bedrock AgentCore is rare. We care more about strong AWS fundamentals and real hands-on work with agent frameworks than about whether you’ve used AgentCore by name. If that’s you, please apply.

FOCUS AREAS

Agent Runtime & Orchestration: Build runtime patterns, memory strategies, orchestration and multi-agent handoffs, and the reference implementations other teams copy.
Gateway, Tools & Integrations: Turn internal APIs, Lambdas and legacy systems into governed tools through AgentCore Gateway, including MCP server development.

Role Responsibilities

Runtime Patterns: Define how agents are structured, packaged and run on AgentCore Runtime, including sessions, state, error handling and timeouts.
Memory Strategies: Design short-term and long-term memory patterns using AgentCore Memory, and guide teams on when to use which.
Orchestration and Multi-Agent Handoffs: Build patterns for planning, tool use, supervisor/worker setups and handoffs between agents, with clear boundaries and fallbacks.
Tool Onboarding: Expose internal REST APIs, Lambda functions and legacy services as agent tools through AgentCore Gateway, using OpenAPI specs and Lambda targets.
MCP Server Development: Design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for systems that need custom integration, with clean tool definitions and schemas.
Governance and Access: Set up authentication and authorization for agents and tools (AgentCore Identity, OAuth, IAM) so agents only reach what they’re allowed to.
Legacy Integration: Work with system owners to wrap older or on-premises systems safely, handling rate limits, data mapping and error cases.
Reference Implementations and Standards: Build production-quality reference agents, starter kits and a repeatable process for adding, versioning and reviewing tools.
Evaluation and Guardrails: Build in evaluation, Bedrock Guardrails, contract tests and safety checks so agents and tools behave predictably before going live.
Enablement: Run walkthroughs, write docs and support the teams onboarding to the platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).
Hands-on experience building LLM agents with at least one agent framework (e.g., Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex).
Practical experience with LLM tool/function calling and handling model output.
Strong AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, containers, DynamoDB/S3, VPC connectivity and Secrets Manager.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and OpenAPI specs, and auth patterns such as OAuth 2.0 and OIDC.
Understanding of agent memory, retrieval (RAG) and context management trade-offs.
Deep hands-on strength in at least one of the two focus areas, and working knowledge of the other.
Clean, well-tested code that other engineers will read and reuse.
Clear communication and comfortable teaching patterns to other teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity). A strong plus, but not required.
Experience building or running MCP servers in a real environment.
Experience with multi-agent systems in production, including observability and failure handling.
Experience integrating with enterprise or legacy systems, or with API management platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong).
Experience with LLM evaluation tools and approaches.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry with data access controls.

Who You Are

You’ve built agents that actually work, and you know where they tend to break
You care about patterns other people can copy, not just clever one-offs
You think about security and access control before anything goes live
You pick up new AWS services quickly and learn by building
You’re honest about what agents can and can’t do today
You work well inside a client team and enjoy helping other engineers succeed
You have prior experience in consulting
Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Data and Platform Tools – Bloomberg Connects
jobs.description:
Location

New York

Business Area

Engineering and CTO

Ref #

10054281

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg Connects is a rapidly growing, free platform that helps museums, galleries, and cultural spaces make their institutions, stories and dynamic content more engaging to audiences around the world. Launched in 2019, Connects features multimedia guides with unique content exclusive to each of our over 1,500 cultural institution partners across 33 countries.

As part of Bloomberg's culture of giving back, Connects is a joint effort between Bloomberg and Bloomberg Philanthropies in support of their work to ensure better, longer lives for the greatest number of people by focusing on five key areas: the arts, education, the environment, government innovation, and public health.

We believe that technology opens doors, and we created Connects as a part of our mission to make art and culture accessible to all—in-person, at-home, and anywhere.

We are a team of designers, researchers, marketers, editors, engineers, and leaders working together to enhance our partner's capacity to reach audiences around the world and improve their visitor experience. Built through empathy and research, qualitative and quantitative data, and experimentation and iteration, our products seek to delight and empower.

The Data and Platform Tools team builds and runs the services behind the platform's analytics, search, speech, computer vision, generative AI, and agentic systems. We are looking for a senior engineer to own the infrastructure those services are built on.

What's in it for you?

Own systems end to end:
Design, build and operate the services behind Connects' analytics, search, speech, computer vision, and AI features, from architecture through to what runs in production.

Work on AI systems in production:
Build and run the infrastructure behind our LLM-based and agentic features, from deployment through evaluation.

Work the way we're building toward:
Use AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices in your own daily work, and help build the internal platform and tooling other disciplines rely on to do the same.

Shape how we build:
Establish the infrastructure, deployment and delivery patterns our services are built on.

Shape global cultural engagement:
Directly impact how millions access and experience art and culture through a rapidly expanding platform.

Contribute to a philanthropic mission:
Align your work with a meaningful initiative supporting arts and cultural accessibility.

We'll Trust You To

Design, build and operate the distributed services that power Connects' analytics, search, speech, computer vision, generative AI, and agentic systems
Build and maintain the infrastructure that runs our AI features in production
Contribute directly to our agentic core platform and tooling — used across engineering and, increasingly, every discipline on the product team
Own the deployment, release and delivery pipelines our services depend on, and raise the standard of how we ship
Take architectural decisions that carry real weight, and distribute that knowledge across the team
Partner with engineering teams across Connects — backend/api, mobile and web teams — on the interfaces and infrastructure our systems share
Participate in a cross-functional agile team spanning design and engineering

You'll Need To Have

5+ years of professional experience designing, developing and releasing high-quality software in Python, C++, C# and/or TypeScript/JavaScript
A Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent work experience

We’d Love To See

Google Cloud Platform — BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Composer, Artifact Registry
Infrastructure as code, particularly Terraform
Designing and owning CI/CD pipelines, including Jenkins
Designing, building and operating distributed systems and services in production
Owning services across their full lifecycle — architecture, deployment, operation and evolution — rather than handing them off
Proficiency in Python
Working with cloud platforms and cloud-native services
Containerized workloads and orchestration
Real, current use of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools in your own work — this is how the team operates, not an occasional aid
Setting technical direction and working independently
Building or operating LLM and agent systems in production, including evaluation frameworks
Experience working in a compiled language such as Go, Rust, C++, etc.
Search infrastructure and indexing pipelines
Vector embeddings/databases and Retrieval Augmented Generation
Speech (TTS/STT) or computer vision systems in production

Salary Range = 160,000 - 240,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

jobs.description:
Our AI & Engineering team helps transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and deliver meaningful impact for clients. In this role, you will work with professionals who are reimagining and reengineering business-critical operations and processes. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, launch new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Software Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for:

Lead development teams in delivering technical solutions using software development life cycle methodologies, including Scrum and Agile
Design, develop, and enhance software systems and custom components using modern development tools and frameworks
Analyze user requirements, system flows, data usage, and performance standards to define technical designs and identify problem areas
Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and develop and execute test procedures for software components
Plan, track, and manage deliverables across short-term sprints and long-term software deployments

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Engineering as a Service offering provides end-to-end design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We help transform engineering teams, modernize technology, & deliver complex programs with a product engineering mindset. Our flexible delivery models- traditional teams, pools, or pods, are tailored for each client's needs, offering engineering-led Advise, Implement, & Operate capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or Management Information Systems
5+ years of full-stack software development experience
5+ years of experience with Modern Full Stack languages (Java, Python, React, Angular, etc.)
Experience orchestrating in cloud and/or serverless environments
Experience with Relational and Non-relational DBs (Postgres, SQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.)
Ability to travel 15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
Active Top Secret security clearance

Preferred:

Experience with Gen AI, Agentic AI, ML/NLP environments and tools
Major Cloud provider certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
AI related certifications (Anthropic, Github, etc.)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $131,000 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: AgentCore Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

We’re hiring AgentCore Platform Engineers to build the agent-facing layer of the platform. That covers how agents run, remember and work together, and how they safely reach the internal systems the business already runs on. Each engineer will have a main focus in one of the two areas below and work closely across both. What you build becomes the template other teams copy, so quality and clarity matter as much as speed. This is a named-team engagement, so the person we propose is the person who starts.

We know production experience with Bedrock AgentCore is rare. We care more about strong AWS fundamentals and real hands-on work with agent frameworks than about whether you’ve used AgentCore by name. If that’s you, please apply.

FOCUS AREAS

Agent Runtime & Orchestration: Build runtime patterns, memory strategies, orchestration and multi-agent handoffs, and the reference implementations other teams copy.
Gateway, Tools & Integrations: Turn internal APIs, Lambdas and legacy systems into governed tools through AgentCore Gateway, including MCP server development.

Role Responsibilities

Runtime Patterns: Define how agents are structured, packaged and run on AgentCore Runtime, including sessions, state, error handling and timeouts.
Memory Strategies: Design short-term and long-term memory patterns using AgentCore Memory, and guide teams on when to use which.
Orchestration and Multi-Agent Handoffs: Build patterns for planning, tool use, supervisor/worker setups and handoffs between agents, with clear boundaries and fallbacks.
Tool Onboarding: Expose internal REST APIs, Lambda functions and legacy services as agent tools through AgentCore Gateway, using OpenAPI specs and Lambda targets.
MCP Server Development: Design and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for systems that need custom integration, with clean tool definitions and schemas.
Governance and Access: Set up authentication and authorization for agents and tools (AgentCore Identity, OAuth, IAM) so agents only reach what they’re allowed to.
Legacy Integration: Work with system owners to wrap older or on-premises systems safely, handling rate limits, data mapping and error cases.
Reference Implementations and Standards: Build production-quality reference agents, starter kits and a repeatable process for adding, versioning and reviewing tools.
Evaluation and Guardrails: Build in evaluation, Bedrock Guardrails, contract tests and safety checks so agents and tools behave predictably before going live.
Enablement: Run walkthroughs, write docs and support the teams onboarding to the platform.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering experience, with strong Python (TypeScript is a plus).
Hands-on experience building LLM agents with at least one agent framework (e.g., Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex).
Practical experience with LLM tool/function calling and handling model output.
Strong AWS fundamentals: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, containers, DynamoDB/S3, VPC connectivity and Secrets Manager.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and OpenAPI specs, and auth patterns such as OAuth 2.0 and OIDC.
Understanding of agent memory, retrieval (RAG) and context management trade-offs.
Deep hands-on strength in at least one of the two focus areas, and working knowledge of the other.
Clean, well-tested code that other engineers will read and reuse.
Clear communication and comfortable teaching patterns to other teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity). A strong plus, but not required.
Experience building or running MCP servers in a real environment.
Experience with multi-agent systems in production, including observability and failure handling.
Experience integrating with enterprise or legacy systems, or with API management platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong).
Experience with LLM evaluation tools and approaches.
Experience in pharma, life sciences or another regulated industry with data access controls.

Who You Are

You’ve built agents that actually work, and you know where they tend to break
You care about patterns other people can copy, not just clever one-offs
You think about security and access control before anything goes live
You pick up new AWS services quickly and learn by building
You’re honest about what agents can and can’t do today
You work well inside a client team and enjoy helping other engineers succeed
You have prior experience in consulting
Prior experience and connections in the Life Sciences industry is preferred

Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.
